help.title: About shipping zones
help.overview: Shipping zones decide which delivery options customers see at checkout and what they cost. Each zone lists countries, if you like states and postal codes, and one or more rates.

sections.title: Rates
items: Free: nothing to pay. Set a minimum order amount to make “free over 50”.

Weight-based, Order amount or Quantity: the rate is offered only when the cart's weight, total or number of items is between its minimum and maximum. For Quantity, enter item counts in the order amount fields.
Carrier and estimated days are shown to the customer; they don't change the price.

sections.title: Matching an address
items: The customer sees every rate of every active zone that matches the address, and picks one.
A zone with no countries matches nothing. Empty states cover the whole country; use * in postal codes, like 10*.
A free-shipping discount removes the charge but still shows the rates.
